title: Address shared care planning and ownership of care coordination
requirements:
- Assess a governed shared, multi-professional care plan as a component with its own governance and exchange rules
- Rename the CDSE feature labelled 'Care coordination' to reflect pathway guidance
- State that the stateless CDSE does not track care commitments across systems or over time
- Identify which component or capability owns longitudinal tracking of a person's care commitments, between CDSE and HMIS
